name: kg_split_succession
description: Era-split a role-reference Entity whose real-world referent changed over time (diachronic disambiguation). 'X's School' four years ago is not 'X's School' today: this op closes the old node's era at split_date, mints a same-label successor whose era opens there, mints the Disambiguation park point at the label (future mentions attach there and the disambiguation scan re-points them by evidence date), chains old --succeeded_by--> successor, and optionally repoints named era-mismatched edges onto the successor. Audited: requires a non-empty `reason`, refuses non-Entity nodes, user-locked nodes, already-closed eras and split dates before the node's start; snapshots into kg_revision_log. Pass `dry_run: true` to preview.

inputs.name: node_id
inputs.description: UUID of the role-reference Entity to split.

inputs.name: split_date
inputs.description: ISO date where the referent changed: the old era's end and the successor's start. Year-floor doctrine applies to loose dates ('fall 2024' -> 2024-09-01 with date_confidence=estimated).

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why this split is correct (the succession evidence). Goes into kg_revision_log.

inputs.name: date_confidence
inputs.description: Confidence for the era boundary: user_set | actual | estimated | inferred. Default estimated.

inputs.name: repoint_edge_ids
inputs.description: Edge UUIDs currently on the old node that belong to the NEW era; they are repointed onto the successor (locked/duplicate edges are skipped and reported, not fatal).

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Preview the split; do not commit. Default false.

outputs.description: {ok, old_node_id, successor_node_id, disambiguation_node_id, succeeded_by_edge_id, repointed, skipped_repoints, revision_log_id}.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_split_succession:
- node_id (required): UUID of the role-reference Entity to split
- split_date (required): ISO date where the referent changed
- reason (required): the succession evidence justifying the split
- date_confidence (optional): user_set | actual | estimated | inferred (default estimated)
- repoint_edge_ids (optional): edges on the old node that belong to the new era
- dry_run (optional): preview only
- finding_id (optional): source finding row id

Example:
{
    "node_id": "node-abc-123",
    "split_date": "2026-09-01",
    "reason": "Evidence shows a new school starting fall 2026; the earlier era's facts describe a different school",
    "date_confidence": "estimated"
}
